name: elatura
description: An adaptive browser sidecar for oversized interactive applications.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint:extension
scripts.lint:extension: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir extension/firefox/dist
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir extension/firefox/dist
scripts.build:extension: npm run build && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir extension/firefox/dist --artifacts-dir artifacts
